experiences.organization: Hoki Jaya Motor, Damay Musik & Project DMP

en: Grew Hoki Jaya Motor TikTok (@hjm_hokijayamotor) and Instagram (@hokijaya_motor) from 0 to 120K+ followers and 5M+ organic views through retention-led short-form video.
Produced commercial short-form product video for SanDisk Phone Drive featured on EAONLINE Official (@eaonlineofficial).
Launched and produced multi-cam music sessions for Damay Musik Subang and Project DMP from zero to full YouTube monetization.
Executed solo end-to-end production as well as coordinated multi-person filming and post-production schedules.
id: Membangun akun TikTok (@hjm_hokijayamotor) & Instagram (@hokijaya_motor) Hoki Jaya Motor dari 0 hingga 120K+ followers dan 5 Juta+ views organik.

Merintis dan memproduksi sesi musik multi-kamera untuk Damay Musik Subang & Project DMP dari nol hingga sukses termonetisasi di YouTube.
Mampu mengeksekusi proyek secara solo end-to-end maupun memimpin tim produksi.

en: Built Malesan (malesan.my.id), a full-stack AI creative companion SaaS (Next.js 16, Supabase, FFmpeg, MediaPipe, Groq Whisper, TTS) featuring viral hook/script generation, YouTube-to-9:16 auto-clipping, synced captions, and Telegram bot automation.
Integrated ElevenLabs, Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Hermes Agent into daily media pipelines and rapid prototyping workflows.
Shipped cross-platform client builds (Web, Windows, Android) and custom portfolio CMS tooling tailored for rapid iteration.

Merilis build lintas platform (Web, Windows, Android) serta sistem CMS portofolio modular yang mudah dikembangkan.
